basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old woman living in Johannesburg, South Africa. I've been on Reddit for about 7 years, and I use it as a place to share my thoughts and seek advice on personal matters. I work as a graphic designer, which allows me to explore my creative side. In my free time, I enjoy exploring the vibrant cultural scene in Johannesburg and going on weekend hikes in the nearby nature reserves. I'm single and have been focusing on personal growth and self-discovery over the past few years. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design from a local university and have worked in the industry for over a decade. My knowledge extends to visual arts, creative software, and a strong understanding of design principles. I also have a keen interest in psychology and personal development, which I explore through reading and engaging in online forums.
